findings.finding: Any record of a listed kind with a PASS-prefixed verdict closes the plan. A later BLOCK of the same kind would not revoke a close, and nothing requires the attesting record named in gate_state.json to be the passing one. Not exploitable today (one PASS per Plan 3 kind).
findings.discharge: Optional: assert that gate_state.json 'attested_by' for a closed plan resolves to a CLOSE_REVIEW_KINDS record with a PASS verdict, or document the limit beside CLOSE_REVIEW_KINDS.

findings.finding: The new test pins the positive (Plan 3 derived closed) and that the fresh record is BLOCK. It does not pin that the fresh BLOCK is excluded. Equal weight: because the delta is already PASS, Plan 3 would derive closed even if the BLOCK were wrongly counted. The exclusion is carried by the 'startswith PASS' filter and is not independently tested. Red-before-green holds for the first assertion, since the old filter only accepted 'plan_close', which no Plan 3 record carries. The commit message claim is plausible, but I did not re-run the old state.
findings.discharge: Optional: add a unit assertion over the record set (for example, closed Plan 3 must not depend on plan3_close_fresh or plan_close_refused) or parametrise _closed_plans_from_records over a synthetic list.

It is history and is labelled as such by 'resumed_on'/'override_lapsed', so it is not wrong, but it is a conditional now fulfilled.

findings.finding: Self-described 'live list, not a dated record' (lines 15-16) carries a banner 'Plan 4 is PAUSED as of 2026-07-29' with 'Resumes when O1, O2 and O3 are discharged and Plan 3 closes'. Both conditions are now met. Line 61 also uses 'Plan 4 is paused' as live phrasing.

Section 11 'Gate state' says 'gate_state.json is the authority: Plan 3 is executed but not closed ..., and Plan 4 is open by owner override and paused', and 'Six steps stand between here and a close.' This contradicts gate_state.json. It is dated 2026-10-27 so it may be a point-in-time record, but it is the same day and names gate_state.json as the authority.
'Plan 3 is not formally closed' and 'Plan 4 was opened by the owner ... override'. The document is dated 2026-07-29 and PROPOSED, so this reads as a dated record, but it has no superseded note.

'Plan 3 ... executed and independently reviewed, not formally closed'. This is an appended 2026-07-29 amendment, and the doctrine says accepted plans are amended by appended note, so it is historical. A newer appended amendment would be the normal route.

docs/progress.md lines 4-12 point to gate_state.json as the authority, and its 'Plan 4 opened by owner authorisation' entry (about line 109) is a dated log entry. REVIEW.md carries no live Plan 3-not-closed or Plan 4-paused claim (it describes the gate mechanism only). Neither is flagged.

rulings.1_tests: CLOSE_REVIEW_KINDS is a frozenset of exactly three kinds and is tight. Across all reviewer_record*.json, plan_close_refused (plan3-close.json, REFUSED), plan3_close_fresh (BLOCK) and every other Plan 3 kind (plan3_close_chain* PASS-WITH-NITS, certification, phase-a.v2, adr-0009) are not in the set or fail the PASS filter, so none is miscounted. Records with plan=None never count. The only passing in-set Plan 3 record is the delta. Plan 2's plan_close is unchanged. Verdict strings are 'PASS-WITH-NITS...' and 'PASS ...', both accepted by startswith('PASS'). The only residual risk is a future record that reuses a listed kind with a PASS verdict (N1).
rulings.2_gate_state: Plan 3 entry (closed, mechanism plan_close_record, attested_by the delta) accurately reflects the records: the delta is plan3_close_fresh_delta, Plan 3, d8d2223, 2026-10-27, 'PASS-WITH-NITS. Plan 3 MAY BE CLOSED'. 'Mechanism' reuses the old value 'plan_close_record' for a different review_kind, which is acceptable and explained in _two_mechanisms_notice. Plan 4 open, with mechanism prior_plan_close, is consistent with test_an_override_is_only_declarable_while_the_prior_plan_is_unclosed (it only constrains entries whose state is open_by_owner_override, and Plan 4 no longer is) and with the CLAUDE.md doctrine (Plan 3's independent PASS now exists). paused_on, paused_reason and the preserved-work list are intact, and resumed_on and override_lapsed are added. The owner quote 'Record the Plan 3 close and end Plan 4's override.' matches the instruction given to me verbatim. as_of 2026-10-27 and as_of_commit 20be8da (the parent of f96237b) are consistent.
rulings.3_readme_and_paper: README Plan 3 and Plan 4 rows and the paper's 'Where the gate actually stands' and chain row 7 agree with gate_state.json and the records, including the dates, d8d2223, the O1-O3 history and the lapse of the override. No overclaim was found. The paper still keeps 'Nothing here may be submitted ... until step 6 issues a PASS', and step 6 now has its PASS. Other chain rows (for example row 5, 'awaiting verification') were not touched and are out of scope.
